{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tlan-Kirr line''' was a line of secret warehouses affiliated to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the brainchild of the Alliance [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tlan]] and of the businesswoman [[Triaz Kirr]]. The latter provided the Rebels with the infrastructures of her trading posts to use as a cover for the hidden warehouses. However, at some point following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Kirr betrayed the Alliance and allowed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to gain control over the line.<ref name="LDF">{{GraalCite|25|Les démons de feu}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Tlan-Kirr line only appeared in ''[[Les démons de feu]]'', a roleplaying adventure published in the [[Graal 25|25th issue]] of French gaming magazine [[Graal (magazine)|''Graal'']].<ref name="LDF" />
